title: HR Generalist
company: VARDHAMAN I Q TOYS PVT LTD
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Human Resource Generalist will run the daily functions of the Human Resource (HR) department including hiring and interviewing staff, administering pay, benefits, and leave, and enforcing company policies and practices.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* May oversee the scheduling, assignments, and daily workflow of subordinate staff in the department.
* May assist with constructive and timely performance evaluations.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Reviews, tracks, and documents compliance with mandatory and non\-mandatory training, continuing education, and work assessments. This may include safety training, anti\-harassment training, professional licensure, and aptitude exams and certifications.
* Recruits, interviews, and facilitates the hiring of qualified job applicants for open positions; collaborates with departmental managers to understand skills and competencies required for openings.
* Conducts or acquires background checks and employee eligibility verifications.
* Implements new hire orientation and employee recognition programs.
* Performs routine tasks required to administer and execute human resource programs including but not limited to compensation, benefits, and leave; disciplinary matters; disputes and investigations; performance and talent management; productivity, recognition, and morale; occupational health and safety; and training and development.
* Handles employment\-related inquiries from applicants, employees, and supervisors, referring complex and/or sensitive matters to the appropriate staff.
* Attends and participates in employee disciplinary meetings, terminations, and investigations.
* Maintains compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and recommended best practices; reviews policies and practices to maintain compliance.
* Maintains knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and new technologies in human resources, talent management, and employment law.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Thorough knowledge of employment\-related laws and regulations.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
* Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn the organizations HRIS and talent management systems.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* At least one year of human resource management experience preferred.
* SHRM\-CP a plus.

title: Sr. HR & Admin Executive
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities – HR \& Administration**

**1\. Human Resource Management**

**Recruitment \& Manpower Planning**

* Identify manpower requirements in consultation with department heads.
* Prepare job descriptions and role specifications for new positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, consultants, social media, and internal references.
* Conduct preliminary screening and coordinate interviews with department managers.
* Manage the entire recruitment cycle including offer letter issuance and joining formalities.
* Maintain a database of potential candidates for future requirements.

**Employee Onboarding \& Induction**

* Conduct joining formalities and documentation for new employees.
* Coordinate induction programs to familiarize employees with company policies, culture, and safety practices.
* Maintain employee personal files and records.

**2\. Performance Management**

**KPI / KRA Setting**

* Coordinate with management and department heads to define **KPIs / KRAs** for employees.
* Ensure KPIs are measurable, achievable, and aligned with company goals.
* Monitor performance periodically and assist in evaluation processes.
* Support annual or quarterly performance appraisal cycles.
* Maintain documentation of performance reviews and improvement plans.

**3\. Payroll \& Statutory Compliance**

**Payroll Management**

* Maintain attendance records and leave management.
* Prepare monthly payroll including salary calculations, overtime, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Ensure timely salary disbursement.
* Maintain payroll records and salary registers.

**Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and regulations.
* Manage statutory contributions such as **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and TDS**.
* Coordinate with auditors and consultants for statutory filings.
* Maintain compliance records and registers.

**4\. Employee Welfare \& Engagement**

* Implement employee welfare programs to promote a positive work environment.
* Address employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Ensure proper facilities such as drinking water, rest areas, and safety measures.
* Organize employee engagement activities, celebrations, and recognition programs.
* Support training and skill development initiatives.

**5\. Administration \& Office Management**

**General Administration**

* Manage day\-to\-day office administration activities.
* Maintain office infrastructure, equipment, and utilities.
* Coordinate with vendors for office supplies, maintenance, and services.
* Ensure workplace cleanliness, safety, and discipline.

**Facility Management**

* Supervise security, housekeeping, and maintenance staff.
* Ensure proper upkeep of office premises, factory areas, and common facilities.
* Coordinate repairs and maintenance activities.

**6\. Housekeeping \& Facility Hygiene**

* Monitor housekeeping staff and maintain cleanliness across office and production areas.
* Ensure waste disposal and hygiene standards are followed.
* Maintain stock of cleaning materials and supplies.
* Conduct regular inspections to maintain workplace hygiene.

**7\. Documentation \& Records**

* Maintain employee records, contracts, and HR documentation.
* Issue HR\-related letters such as appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and relieving letters.
* Maintain attendance, leave records, and employee database.

**8\. Policy Implementation**

* Ensure employees follow company policies and procedures.
* Assist management in implementing new HR policies and administrative systems.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Summary:

We are looking for a detail\-oriented Aeronautical Engineering fresher to join our documentation and records management team. The role involves maintaining, organizing, and updating engineering and technical records related to aircraft design, testing, maintenance, and certification processes. This is a desk\-based position ideal for candidates who have a strong technical background and excellent data management skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date technical records for aircraft systems, components, and design data.

Support the engineering team in documenting test reports, design revisions, and inspection summaries.

Ensure all documents comply with aerospace standards and regulatory requirements (DGCA, FAA, EASA, etc.).

Assist in the preparation and review of engineering documentation, such as drawings, maintenance logs, and material certifications.

Update and manage the document control system to track version history and approvals.

Coordinate with design, maintenance, and quality teams to gather required technical data.

Generate periodic reports and summaries for internal and regulatory audits.

Handle data entry, filing, and electronic record management in compliance with organizational standards.

Required Skills:

Strong understanding of aeronautical principles and documentation standards.

Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and basic familiarity with CAD or PLM tools (added advantage).

Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

Good communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently on documentation tasks and manage deadlines.

Preferred Attributes:

Knowledge of aircraft maintenance logs, design drawings, or regulatory documentation.

Familiarity with ISO 9001 / AS9100 quality management systems.

Interest in building a career in technical documentation, quality assurance, or compliance within the aerospace industry.

title: Workplace Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description** – Manager (CL\-7\)

**Job Title**: Workplace Service Delivery Manager (CL\-7\)

**Management Level**: CL – 7

**Work Location**: Mumbai

**Must have Skills**: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

**Good to have Skills**: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification

**Department**: Corporate Function

**Job Summary**


Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Integrated Facility management**

* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly/ quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.

**Engineering and Technical Services**

* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety. Leverage tools to improve quality of services, including office meters, sensors and SLA tracking.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

**Statutory Compliance and Risks**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**

* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.

**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.

**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**

* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.

**Team Management**

* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**

* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.

**Projects and Transitions**

* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.

**Professional \& Technical Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word), working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Mumbai offices.

  

**Experience**: Minimum 10 years of military experience with at least 4 \- 5 years of corporate IFM experience for Veterans/ Min 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration for others.

**Educational Qualification**: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full\-time MBA or both would be an added advantage.

description:
### **About Axis Max Life**


Axis Max Life Insurance Limited, formerly known as Max Life Insurance Company Ltd., is a joint venture between Max Financial Services Limited (“MFSL”) and Axis Bank Limited.


Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive protection and long\-term savings life insurance solutions through its multi\-channel distribution, including agency and third\-party distribution partners. It has built its operations over two decades through a need\-based sales process, a customer\-centric approach to engagement and service delivery, and a well\-trained human capital.


Axis Max Life has been consistently ranked among the best workplaces by the GPTW Institute, reflecting its commitment to creating a positive and empowering work environment.

***\#ComeAsYouAre LGBTQIA\+ and PwD candidates of all ages are encouraged to apply***

**Job Description**


Job Description:  

  

Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager for our Proprietary HR \- Tied Agency division. This role is essential for driving talent management strategies, optimizing recruitment processes, and fostering a high\-performance culture within the organization. The Senior Manager will lead a team responsible for various HR functions, including talent acquisition, performance management, employee engagement, and learning and development, specifically tailored towards our tied agency channel.  

  

Key Responsibilities:  

  

* Develop and implement HR strategies and programs that align with the organization’s goals for the tied agency business.
* Oversee the recruitment process for the tied agency channels, ensuring the attraction and retention of top talent.
* Collaborate with leadership to identify workforce planning needs and develop succession plans for critical roles.
* Drive performance management initiatives and ensure effective appraisal systems are in place.
* Foster a culture of employee engagement through various initiatives and programs.
* Implement training and development programs that enhance employees' skills and performance.
* Monitor HR metrics and provide insights to leadership for data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and internal HR policies.

  

Skills and Tools Required:  

  

* Extensive experience in HR management, particularly within the insurance or financial services sector.
* Strong knowledge of talent acquisition strategies, workforce planning, and employee engagement.
* Proven track record of leading HR teams and driving performance in a sales\-driven environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels.
* Proficiency in HR software systems and tools for managing employee data, performance metrics, and recruitment processes.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret HR metrics and translate them into actionable strategies.

title: HR & Recruitment Manager
description:
Human Resources (HR) – Job Description

Job Title: Human Resources Executive / Manager

Department: Human Resources

Reports To: Managing Director / HR Head / Operations Head

Job Summary

The Human Resources (HR) Executive/Manager is responsible for managing recruitment, employee relations, payroll coordination, training, and HR administration. The role ensures smooth HR operations and compliance with company policies and labor laws.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment \& Staffing

Identify hiring needs and prepare job descriptions.

Post job advertisements on job portals and social media.

Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.

Conduct interviews and coordinate with department heads.

Issue offer letters and manage the onboarding process.

2\. Employee Relations

Maintain positive employee relations within the organization.

Address employee grievances and workplace issues.

Ensure discipline and adherence to company policies.

3\. HR Administration

Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR documentation.

Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, and relieving letters.

Manage attendance and leave records.

4\. Payroll \& Benefits

Coordinate with accounts for salary processing.

Maintain records of incentives, bonuses, and deductions.

Ensure timely salary disbursement.

5\. Training \& Development

Identify training needs of employees.

Organize orientation and training programs for staff.

Monitor employee performance and development.

6\. Compliance \& Policies

Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies.

Implement HR policies and procedures.

Maintain confidentiality of employee information.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.

HR certification is an added advantage.

Experience

2–5 years of experience in Human Resources or related field.

title: CNC Operator
description:
**Job Summary**:  
The CNC Operator is responsible for operating CNC machinery to produce high\-quality furniture parts, ensuring that all products meet the company’s specifications and quality standards. This role requires attention to detail, precision, and a strong understanding of machine operations and programming basics. The CNC Operator will work closely with the production team to meet daily production goals, follow safety standards, and maintain equipment.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* **Machine Operation**
* Set up and operate CNC machines (routers, lathes, mills) used in the production of furniture parts.
* Input and adjust machine settings (e.g., speed, feed rate, depth of cut) to achieve required dimensions and surface finishes.
* Load raw materials and execute pre\-programmed machine instructions.
* **Quality Control**
* Inspect completed parts for accuracy using callipers, micrometres, and other measuring instruments.
* Perform quality checks on work to ensure products meet company specifications and customer expectations.
* Troubleshoot any machining issues aend adjust settings as needed to maintain quality standards.
* **Maintenance and Safety**
* Perform routine maintenance on CNC equipment, such as cleaning and minor repairs.
* Report major machine malfunctions or maintenance needs to the maintenance department.
* Follow all safety protocols and keep the work area clean and organized.
* **Collaboration and Documentation**
* Work closely with engineers and production supervisors to understand project requirements and production timelines.
* Document production output, material usage, and any equipment issues for reporting purposes.

**Qualifications**:

· Diploma/Engineering – Mechanical/Production/Instrumentation/Electrical/Electronics

· ITI – Electrical/Mechanical

* High school diploma or equivalent; technical or vocational training in CNC operations preferred.
* Strong understanding of CNC programming basics and ability to make minor adjustments to code as needed.

**Physical Requirements**:

* Standing for long periods, bending, and reaching during machine operation.

With a strong **learning culture and focus on professional development**, TULS Corp has **fully sponsored over 10 employees for international project tours and training programs**, reflecting its commitment to nurturing talent and providing **global exposure**.

**Role Overview**

This role is ideal for **fresh engineering graduates** who are passionate about renewable energy and aspire to build a **long\-term consulting career** in this fast\-growing sector.  
You will work alongside senior consultants and engineers on **solar, wind, hydro, and hybrid power assignments**, contributing to technical, financial, and sustainability\-focused deliverables across India and abroad.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the preparation of **feasibility studies, Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), and techno\-commercial analyses**.
* Conduct **energy data analysis**, performance benchmarking, and cost assessment.
* Prepare **technical presentations, project documentation, and client reports**.
* Undertake **research on renewable energy technologies, government policies, and market trends**.
* Participate in **project review meetings**, internal training sessions, and professional development programs.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education:**

* B.E. / B.Tech. in **Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, or Energy Engineering** with **minimum First Class or above\-average (7\.00 CGPA)**.

**Experience:**

* Fresh graduates with excellent academic performance and strong analytical aptitude.

**Skills:**

* Analytical reasoning and numerical aptitude
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and report preparation
* Effective communication and teamwork skills

**Attributes:**

* Hardworking, disciplined, detail\-oriented, and eager to learn.

**Exclusions:**

* Candidates from **IT, Computer Science, or Software Engineering** backgrounds will **not** be considered.

**Compensation \& Growth Path**

* **Starting Stipend:** ₹12,500 per month (for the first two months)
* **Revised Salary:** Minimum ₹20,000 per month (post two\-month performance review)
* **Growth:** Direct mentorship from senior experts and exposure to **international renewable energy assignments**.
* **Career Path:** Opportunity to progress into **Consultant / Engineer roles** based on performance and learning milestones.

**Why Join TULS Corp**

* Work on **live renewable energy projects** shaping India’s clean energy transition.
* Collaborate with **multidisciplinary teams** across solar, wind, hydro, and hybrid systems.
* Gain **international exposure** through sponsored project visits and learning programs.
* Be part of a **growth\-oriented organization** that values innovation, ethics, and excellence.

**Selection Process**

* **Video Introduction:**
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited to share a short video introduction before the personal interview.
* This step helps streamline the initial evaluation and avoids unnecessary travel.
* **Aptitude Test \& Personal Interview:**
* Candidates shortlisted post video review will be invited to the **TULS Corp Thane office** for a short **aptitude test** followed by a **one\-on\-one interview**.

**Application Note:**

If you are an engineer with **strong academics, analytical skills, and a passion for renewable energy**, this is your opportunity to build a high\-impact career in a globally growing industry.

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
To manage and secure the agency’s digital infrastructure, develop and maintain professional websites for the agency and academy, and provide technical support for cyber\-crime investigations.

​Key Responsibilities

​Web Development: Build, maintain, and optimize the Chercheur Investigators and Detective Academy websites (WordPress, MERN, or PHP).

​Vulnerability Assessment (VAPT): Perform regular "Penetration Testing" on your own systems to ensure no client data can be leaked.

​Digital Forensics: Assist field investigators in tracking IP addresses, recovering deleted data, and analyzing social media footprints for active cases.

​SEO \& Security: Ensure the website is SEO\-friendly to attract leads while keeping it protected from DDoS attacks and SQL injections.

​Cyber Training: Help create curriculum content for the "Cyber/Forensic" modules of your Elite Intelligence Training Program.

​Technical Requirements

​Hacking Skills: Proficiency in tools like Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark, and Burp Suite.

​Development Skills: Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend frameworks (Node.js, Python/Django, or PHP).

​Certifications: CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) or OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) is a major plus.

​Database Management: Experience with SQL and NoSQL to manage voter lists and lead databases securely.

​Soft Skills

​Absolute Integrity: Since they will have access to your servers and "backdoor" info, a background check is mandatory.

​Problem\-Solving: The ability to think like a criminal to protect the agency’s assets.

​Confidentiality: Must sign a strict Non\-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

As a Co\-Founder, you will not be an employee. You will own your domain. You will work *on* the company as much as *in* it — shaping the product, the team, and the commercial direction of a technology platform that is already in the field.

company: Boston Diabetes [ A Unit of Medica Metrirx]
description:
**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) / KPIs**

**1\. Sales \& Commercial Growth**

* Drive pharmacy sales by ensuring **100% fulfillment** of all internal prescriptions from clinic doctors.
* Educate patients on the critical importance of specialty supplements (e.g., Ultra Q300, Alafin) to improve their therapy outcomes.
* Manage discount structures while strictly maintaining target profit margins.
* Identify and document the number of patients who consulted but did not purchase medicines, including the specific reasons for non\-purchase.

**2\. Inventory \& Vendor Management**

* Negotiate purchase margins and credit periods with pharmaceutical distributors.
* Source and onboard new vendors specifically for specialized diabetic care products such as CGM sensors, insulin pumps, and orthopedic supports.
* Conduct weekly physical stock verification (Actual vs. System Stock) and manage "Returns to Vendor" (RTV) for near\-expiry or damaged goods.
* Perform monthly "Near\-Expiry" audits with a **6\-month window** to liquidate stock before it becomes a loss.

**3\. Clinical \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain strict, documented temperature logs for insulin and other biologicals.
* Ensure 100% adherence to statutory requirements, including **Drug License, Schedule H/H1 registers, and Narcotics records**.
* Oversee and document the movement of medicines from the pharmacy to ISR therapy rooms and ensure all unused returns are collected immediately.
* Audit billing accuracy daily to prevent any unauthorized dispensing or financial leakage.

**4\. Daily Clinic Closure \& Reporting**

* Ensure all cash, credit, and digital payments are reconciled against the daily sales summary.
* Conduct a "Random 10\-Item" physical count every evening to verify system accuracy.
* Submit the mandatory **Daily Pharmacy Report (DPR)** by **8:00 PM** sharp, covering sales, stock\-out alerts, and leakage analysis.

* Proficient in using multimeters, IR testers, HV testers, and other QC tools

* Knowledge of root cause analysis tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram)
* Exposure to lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies

We are a growing garment manufacturing company specializing in high\-quality men’s shirts including Oxford, Twill, Satin, and other woven fabrics. We cater to apparel brands, private label companies, and bulk buyers across India. Our focus is on delivering quality manufacturing solutions while building long\-term partnerships with fashion brands and institutional buyers.

Designation: Manager


Location: India Maharashtra Thane \- GCorp


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

  

Job Description :


The incumbent will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end process of Group Health Insurance policy issuance and endorsement operations, ensuring accurate premium computation, underwriting compliance, and timely service delivery. The role involves handling complete policy issuance activities including validation of underwriting approval, sum insured structure, age band pricing, family definitions, negotiated rates, loadings, discounts, and applicable taxes. The candidate will ensure that policy schedules, certificates of insurance and related documentation are generated accurately and dispatched within defined turnaround times. Close coordination with underwriting, sales, finance, IT, TPA teams, brokers, corporate HR representatives, bancassurance partners, and agency channels is an integral part of the role.


The position requires managing all types of endorsements such as member additions, deletions, sum insured corrections, member detail corrections, and refund or adjustment cases. The candidate must perform pro\-rata premium calculations for additions and deletions, validate financial impact, apply underwriting loadings where applicable, and ensure proper approval workflow for refund endorsements. Every endorsement request must be verified against policy terms and underwriting guidelines before processing. The role demands strong financial accuracy to avoid revenue leakage and ensure compliance with approved quotation terms.


Data validation and quality control form a critical part of the responsibilities. The candidate will perform detailed data sanity checks including validation of date of birth, age calculation, relationship mapping, duplicate member identification, sum insured verification, gender validation, and premium reconciliation. Maintaining error\-free processing standards and ensuring audit readiness through proper documentation and system updates are key expectations.


The role also involves active stakeholder management. The incumbent will regularly interact with brokers, corporate HR teams, bancassurance and agency partners to clarify policy terms, resolve premium disputes, manage escalations, and provide service updates. Internally, coordination with underwriting, sales, operations, claims, and finance teams is necessary to ensure smooth workflow and adherence to service level agreements.


The candidate will be responsible for monitoring turnaround times for policy issuance and endorsement processing, maintaining daily trackers, managing pending cases, and ensuring adherence to defined service standards. Preparation of MIS reports including issuance volume, endorsement volume, premium variance, productivity reports, and error ratio tracking is also part of the role.

**About this role** :


**The Recruiter provides an absolutely pivotal role in our success story at Gartner. Working in partnership with the business you will be responsible for sourcing and assessing great talent for our organization. Working at Gartner, you will have the fantastic opportunity to see the development of associates you have engaged and feel proud to have been part of their achievements.**

**What you’ll do:**

* **Source, qualify and match candidates to defined profiles and specific open requisitions across assigned Business Units.**
* **Develop a thorough understanding of the profiles for which you are searching by forming and maintaining a relationship with hiring managers.**
* **Utilize knowledge of multiple recruiting sources and execute innovative recruiting strategies**
* **Work with a database for sourcing and tracking of candidates**

**What you’ll need:**

* **4\-7 years’ experience in a corporate or agency recruitment role**
* **A consistent track\-record of success in a metrics or goal\-based talent acquisition setting**
* **Strong time\-management and organizational skills**
* **Someone with determination and a focus on delivering results**

**What we offer:**

* **A seat to the table to help drive peak performance in a growing, people business.**
* **Encouragement to be innovative and challenge status quo.**
* **Exposure to industry leading training and development.**
* **Performance based recognition and rewards.**

  

**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 21,000 associates globally who support \~14,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.  



  

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.


Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. description:
**A bit about us**
------------------


Trek is an awesome place to work, with amazing benefits for all employees. We build only products we love, provide incredible hospitality to our customers, and change the world by getting more people on bikes. When you’re on our team, you’re taken care of, encouraged to learn and grow, and given lots of opportunities to do so. Give us your best, and we’ll give it right back. Sound pretty sweet? Then come join us!

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The HRIS Analyst** is a Workday specialist with a particular expertise in **Workday Payroll configuration and processing**, responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable payroll operations. This role analyzes, implements, and maintains Workday to support HR, Payroll, and operations, with a strong focus on payroll accuracy, tax compliance, absence\-to\-pay integration, and payroll\-related feature adoption. The analyst optimizes system functionality, ensures data integrity, and delivers payroll\-first solutions while balancing operational support with strategic initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday System Management and Support**

* Act as Workday SME, guiding stakeholders/cross\-functional teams on solutions for business issues.
* Maintain system (security, processes, reporting, integrations, data loads); troubleshoot, escalate, manage Jira/HR tickets.
* Balance support (ticketing/ad\-hoc) with projects.
* Deliver proactive training/consultation/knowledge transfer on changes/enhancements/implementations.
* Maintain business process docs, user guides, and update communications.
* Ensure internal controls via audits/compliance checks.

**Feature Release Pre\-Planning and Adoption**

* Participate in biannual release pre\-planning: review notes early, evaluate features, assess strategic fit (priorities, ROI, goals).
* Prioritize/recommend adoptions for efficiencies/relationships/benefits; develop value props for leadership.
* Execute implementations (testing, config, change management, user awareness) for smooth adoption.
* Engage Workday roadmap: attend Rising/user groups, network Community, influence as customer voice.

**Payroll Configuration**

* Configure payroll (earnings codes, deductions, tax integrations) for accurate withholding/compliance/tax ties.
* Support processing: test configs, resolve integrations, guide requirements.

**Absence Management**

* Configure absences/time\-off (accruals, balances, sequencing like pro\-ration/carryover) per policies/laws.
* Optimize workflows for efficiency, self\-service, and payroll/benefits integration.

**Analytics and Reporting**

* Build/run/maintain reports/dashboards for HR/Payroll/business insights to drive strategies/decisions.
* Support compensation via grading profiles/eligibility configs as needed.
* Perform data audits/analysis for accuracy/HCM support.

**Project Management and Process Improvement**

* Serve as business analyst: partner with users, understand needs, leverage Workday solutions.
* Prioritize/manage multiple projects (impact/effort/alignment); develop efficient processes.
* Propose enhancements in strategic meetings for adoption/efficiencies/outcomes.
* Maintain vendor ties (Workday/consultants); track trends/best practices to advocate needs.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s in HR, IT, or related.
* 3\-5\+ years Workday config; prefer payroll (earnings/tax) and absence (calculations/sequencing) expertise.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Deep Workday knowledge (architecture, security, reporting, integrations).
* Proficient in Excel, Workday reports/dashboards; familiar with Community.
* Strong oral/written communication; "client service" mindset, collaborative/non\-adversarial.
* Proven PM/process improvement/analytical skills: prioritize, solve problems, drive change in fast\-paced settings.
* Builds trust/cross\-functional relationships for goals.
* Inquisitive/creative/innovative; urgent on docs/results.
* Handles confidential info discreetly; delivers incredible hospitality.
* Multitasks (support/projects); focuses on deadlines.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About the Role**

We are a growing real estate company based in Mumbai seeking an experienced and proactive HR Manager to take full ownership of all human resource functions. The company is building a custom software portal for HR operations, and the ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all HR activities through it, including hiring, terminations, attendance tracking, performance monitoring, EPF compliance, and increment decisions. This is a solo HR leadership role where you will be the single point of contact for all employee\-related matters, shielding senior leadership from day\-to\-day people issues while building a disciplined, performance\-driven work culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

\- Own end\-to\-end hiring across all departments, especially high\-turnover sales roles. Screen, interview, shortlist, and manage onboarding (documentation, induction, role clarity).

**Employee Lifecycle \& Retention**

\- Handle exits (resignation, exit interviews, knowledge transfer, full \& final). Conduct regular one\-on\-ones and stay interviews to identify flight risks early. Design retention strategies tailored to the challenges of real estate sales.

**Performance Management \& Increments**

\- Track attendance, task completion, and performance via the HR portal. Run quarterly and annual reviews based on portal data. Recommend increments strictly on documented performance, not tenure. Prepare PIPs for underperformers. Set measurable KPIs with department heads.

**Attendance \& Discipline**

\- Monitor tardiness, early departures, and absenteeism through the portal. Enforce punctuality via progressive discipline. Manage leave requests in accordance with company policy and the government holiday calendar.

**Compliance**

\- Maintain all employee records, contracts, and documentation.

**HR Portal \& Technology**

\- Manage all HR operations through the company's custom software portal. Generate performance reports and dashboards for leadership. Coordinate with the dev team on portal improvements.

**Employee Relations**

\- Act as the sole point of contact for all employee grievances and queries, keeping senior management out of routine matters. Mediate conflicts, run team meetings, and use psychological insight to address disengagement.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education:** MBA/PGDM in HR Management. A background in psychology (especially Industrial/Organizational Psychology) is strongly preferred.

**Experience:** 4–7 years as an HR generalist handling independent, end\-to\-end operations. Minimum 2 years in real estate, construction, or a high\-turnover sales\-driven industry. Experience managing 30–150 employees and hiring 5–15\+ roles per month. Hands\-on EPF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, and Maharashtra labour law knowledge.

**Core HR Skills:** Full\-cycle recruitment, performance management \& KPI tracking, compensation benchmarking, attendance \& discipline enforcement, HR software proficiency, data\-driven reporting.

**Behavioral Skills:** Emotional intelligence, conflict resolution, motivational interviewing basics, employee engagement, assertive communication, behavioral observation \& early warning detection, cultural sensitivity for Mumbai's diverse workforce.

**Languages:** English and Hindi (mandatory). Marathi.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
The Company:
**Serving the People Who Serve the People**  

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.  

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud\-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.  

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.
Job Summary:

The HR Generalist at Granicus is the **primary HR partner for employees and people managers in India**, responsible for delivering a consistent and positive employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.  

This role serves as the **first point of contact** for all HR\-related queries, employee relations, and HR operations. The HR Generalist plays a critical role in ensuring employees feel **welcomed, supported, heard, and treated fairly**, while enabling managers to lead effectively and in compliance with company policies and local regulations.  

A key focus of this role is to **drive employee engagement and culture** through onboarding, offboarding, communication, celebrating employee events, recognition activities and HR engagement programs while maintaining the **highest standards of integrity, confidentiality, data accuracy, and compliance**.
What Your Impact Will Look Like:
**Employee Experience \& HR Operations (Hire to Retire)*** Own the employee experience lifecycle including onboarding, induction, ongoing support, and offboarding.
* Lead new joiner welcoming and HR induction programs, covering company overview, HR policies, benefits, and employee resources.
* Act as the first point of contact for all HR queries, ensuring timely, accurate, and empathetic responses to employees and managers.
* Manage end\-to\-end offboarding, including exit documentation, experience letters, full \& final coordination, and conducting exit interviews with actionable insights.
* Support investigations related to workplace conduct, grievances, or policy concerns, maintaining confidentiality and objectivity.

 **HR Policies, Compliance \& Data Accuracy*** Support implementation and ongoing administration of HR policies \& benefits, compliance requirements (e.g., maternity benefits, leave policies).
* Ensure high level of data accuracy across employee records, reports, letters, and HR documentation.
* Maintain standardized HR templates, letters, and employee records, ensuring consistency and audit readiness.

 **HRIS Implementation \& Reporting*** Support and drive adoption of HRMIS platforms, ensuring data integrity, process alignment, and user readiness.
* Partner with HRIS/global teams to maintain accurate people data and reporting across HR programs.

 **Employee Engagement \& Culture*** Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, including festive celebrations, cultural events, recognition activities, and team events (onsite/offsite).
* Partner with leadership to strengthen employee connection, morale, and retention through meaningful engagement efforts.

 **Stakeholder Partnership*** Build strong, trusted relationships with employees, managers, and HR partners.
* Provide high\-quality HR customer service, ensuring HR is seen as approachable, responsive, and value driven.


You Will Love This Job If You Have:
**5\+ years of experience** as an HR Generalist
Excellent **interpersonal skills** with the ability to engage confidently with employees and managers at all levels.
High attention to detail with a **strong focus on data accuracy and documentation**.
Demonstrated ability to handle **confidential and sensitive matters with integrity and discretion**.
Strong communication skills — clear, empathetic, and professional (written and verbal).
Comfortable working with HR systems and **MS Office**, including reporting and presentations.
Sound judgment, practical problem\-solving ability, and a **people\-first mindset**.
About Us:

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit! **Security and Privacy Requirements*** Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
* Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

 **The Team*** We are a remote\-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

 **The Culture*** At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to be  

a part of our journey.
* A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
* Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important and  

sometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work\-life balance and current affairs.
* Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
* We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employee  

population

 **The Impact*** We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.


We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes a separate fintech entity with its flagship product, PRECISION, a risk management solution, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site Flygresor.se, Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, and Wenrix, the embedded AI platform for flights. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.


Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.


Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

Etraveli Group is the globally leading company for tech solutions and fulfillment capabilities for


online sales of flights. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers


across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We hold consumer online travel


agency brands like Mytrip, GoToGate \& Flight Network and serve Booking.com with flights. Etraveli


Group has also established strategic partnerships with companies like Skyscanner, Google Flights,


TUI, etc.


Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our


diverse team of more than 3000 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech


wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Our major offices are in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India,


Canada, Poland and Uruguay.


**Location** : Pune


**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* Monitor and identify failed flight bookings in the system
* Assist in booking \& issuance of the flights on Airline website and Portals
* Coordinate with Airlines, Suppliers, and internal teams for smooth fulfillment
* Maintain booking accuracy and update records
* Fare rule interpretation
* Ancillary product Fulfillment
* Error reporting
* Processing Refunds on Airline website and Portals

**Requirements :**

* Any Fresher/Non travel background experience
* Willing to work in rotational shifts 24/7 (Night Shifts Included)
* Minimum Qualification: Undergraduate \- Diploma / HSC pass (10\+2\)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Well organized, persistent with multitasking skills
* Self\-driven, proactive, and results\-oriented
* Proficiency with computers and MS Office
* Strong attention to detail, quick learner, and team player
* Ability to manage change and work under pressure

**Benefits**


What’s in it for You?

* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential, free support for personal or work\-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well\-being and performance.
* **Term Life Insurance:** Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed\-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.
* **Mediclaim (Health Insurance):** Extensive coverage for medical expenses to ensure you and your family get the care you need when it matters.
* **Meal Coupons:** A tasty perk to fuel your workday—delicious meals or snacks on us!
* **Performance\-Based Incentives:** Earn more when you deliver more. Your hard work pays off—literally.
* **Learning \& Development (L\&D) Sessions:** Continued growth through curated upskilling sessions—boosting your skills and career progression.

##### **Diversity disclaimer**

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* *During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti\-discrimination law or regulation.*

title: F&B Associate
description:
F\&B Associate

Z Hotels \| Zolo

Serve with warmth. Move with speed. Deliver dining experiences

guests remember.

Why this role exists

Z Hotels is expanding — and dining is a core part of the guest experience.

Guests may come for the room. But they remember how they were served.

In F\&B, every interaction matters —

from greeting at the table

to order accuracy

to how complaints are handled.

As occupancy grows, service speed, hygiene, and coordination must remain consistent.

This role exists to ensure every guest receives attentive, hygienic, and efficient dining service

— without friction.

Your mandate is clear:

● Deliver warm and professional dining interactions

● Maintain speed without compromising accuracy

● Protect hygiene standards at all times

● Support table turnover and revenue growth

● Contribute to smooth shift coordination

This is not a food\-serving role. It is an experience\-delivery role.

About Zolo and Z Hotels

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new

generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

What you will be responsible for

Deliver Service With Smile \& Guest Warmth

● Greet guests warmly upon arrival

● Maintain eye contact and positive body language

● Speak politely and confidently

● Check on guest satisfaction during service

● Handle complaints calmly and respectfully

● Maintain approachable presence

Maintain Service Speed \& Coordination

● Take orders promptly

● Communicate clearly with kitchen

● Ensure correct order delivery

● Respond quickly to additional requests

● Process billing efficiently

● Coordinate smoothly during peak hours

Protect Hygiene \& Presentation Standards

● Maintain clean and proper uniform

● Follow hand hygiene practices

● Ensure tables are clean before seating

● Handle food safely

● Maintain cleanliness of service station

Demonstrate Product Knowledge \& Suggestive Selling

● Explain menu items clearly

● Recommend dishes based on guest preference

● Suggest add\-ons or beverages appropriately

● Know availability and special offers

● Answer dietary queries confidently

Ensure Attention to Detail \& Order Accuracy

● Confirm order before sending to kitchen

● Check order before serving

● Deliver to correct table

● Verify billing accuracy

● Rectify mistakes quickly

Support Team Coordination \& Shift Discipline

● Report on time for shift

● Communicate clearly with kitchen staff

● Support team during peak hours

● Maintain smooth handover between shifts

● Escalate service issues appropriately

Who this role is for

You will likely thrive here if:

● You enjoy interacting with people

● You stay energetic during busy hours

● You notice small details

● You value cleanliness and presentation

● You are comfortable recommending products

● You enjoy working in a team environment

Experience we value

● 0–2 years in F\&B, hospitality, or service roles

● Freshers with strong communication and energy welcome

● Basic understanding of menu handling helpful

● Willingness to work rotational shifts

● Groomed appearance and service mindset

Experience matters less than attitude and discipline.

The impact you will have

You will shape how guests remember their dining experience.

You will influence repeat visits and reviews.

You will contribute directly to revenue through efficient service and upselling.

Why join now

Z Hotels is expanding its hospitality footprint.

As we grow, dining quality and service discipline will define brand perception.

If you believe service is a craft — this is the right moment.

title: Futures IP Services Analyst-1
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

**Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2024\-2025 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution
 **About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

**Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (8 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
We are seeking a creative and detail\-oriented **Prompt Engineer** to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing prompts that guide AI models to generate accurate, relevant, and high\-quality responses. You will work with advanced AI tools such as ChatGPT and solutions built using APIs from OpenAI to develop effective prompts for various business applications.

As a Prompt Engineer, you will collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and content teams to build AI\-powered workflows and improve user interactions with AI systems. Your primary responsibility will be to craft clear, structured prompts that help AI models understand tasks and deliver consistent results. You will also evaluate AI outputs, identify errors such as hallucinations, and refine prompts to improve response quality and reliability.

The role requires strong written communication skills and an analytical mindset. You should be comfortable experimenting with different prompt formats, testing outputs, and iterating quickly to achieve better performance. Understanding concepts from Natural Language Processing and how large language models process text will help you succeed in this position.

Candidates with basic programming knowledge in languages like Python or JavaScript will have an advantage, as these skills can help integrate prompts into applications, automate workflows, and interact with AI APIs.

The ideal candidate is curious, detail\-focused, and passionate about artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. If you enjoy working with language, solving problems creatively, and exploring innovative AI solutions, this role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of intelligent AI\-driven products and experiences.

title: Senior UI/UX Developer (Astro & SSG Specialist)
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a versatile **UI/UX Developer** with a "Product Designer" mindset and "Frontend Engineer" skills. You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end creation of modern, high\-performance web experiences. The ideal candidate doesn't just make things look pretty; they architect them for speed, scalability, and seamless content management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Delivery:** Own the entire lifecycle of a website, from initial UX research and wireframing to high\-fidelity UI design and final production code.
* **Astro Architecture:** Lead the development of websites using the **Astro framework**, leveraging its "islands architecture" to deliver zero\-JS\-by\-default performance.
* **High\-Volume Content Management:** Design and implement scalable content structures (via Headless CMS or Markdown) that remain performant even with thousands of pages.
* **Performance Optimization:** Ensure all builds achieve near\-perfect Lighthouse scores, focusing on Core Web Vitals, image optimization, and efficient asset delivery.
* **Iterative Design:** Create prototypes and design systems in Figma/Adobe XD that translate directly into clean, maintainable code.

**Technical Requirements**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of professional experience in UI/UX design and frontend development.
* **Framework Mastery:** Deep, hands\-on experience with **Astro** and at least one other **Static Site Generator (SSG)** (e.g., Hugo, Eleventy, Jekyll, or Next.js).
* **Frontend Fundamentals:** Expert\-level knowledge of HTML5, modern CSS (Tailwind CSS, Sass, or CSS Modules), and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* **Performance First:** Proven ability to build "insanely fast" websites. You should understand "Partial Hydration," lazy loading strategies, and CDN caching.
* **Design Tools:** Mastery of Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD, with a strong portfolio showcasing modern typography, layout, and user\-centric flows.
* **Content Workflows:** Experience integrating with Headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi) or managing large\-scale content via Git\-based workflows.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Experience with Web Animations (GSAP, Framer Motion).
* Knowledge of SEO best practices for static sites.
* Basic understanding of backend integrations or Edge Functions (Netlify/Vercel).

**What We Value**

* **The "Speed" Obsession:** You hate slow websites as much as we do.
* **Attention to Detail:** You notice when a margin is 1px off.
* **Autonomy:** You can take a vague idea and turn it into a fully functional, beautiful digital product.

title: HR Intern- Onboarding & Engagement
description:
About Lokal :
   

  

 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
