 Typical Duties

* Collaborate with IT staff on integration of new applications and systems.

* Train and mentor junior network staff on Juniper best practices.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware procurement, support, and warranty claims.



 Work Environment
 


* Primarily office\-based with potential for hybrid remote work arrangements.
* May require travel to branch offices, data centers, or client sites.
* Participation in scheduled maintenance windows, including nights or weekends, as needed.
* Adherence to organizational policies, security practices, and change management protocols.



 Career Path and Advancement
 



 A Network Engineer – Juniper Specialist will have opportunities for career advancement into senior technical roles such as Senior Network Engineer, Network Architect, or Network Security Lead. With continued certification and experience, one could progress to management positions or specialize further in areas like cybersecurity, cloud networking, or network automation.
 



 About the Employer
 



 Employers seeking a Juniper Network Engineer are typically organizations with significant investments in Juniper hardware or service provider environments, including enterprise IT departments, managed service providers, telecommunications companies, and government agencies. A commitment to technical excellence, continuous improvement, and operational security is central to the organizational culture.
 



 Application Process
 



 Interested candidates should submit a detailed resume highlighting their Juniper experience, certifications, and relevant project work. Cover letters should address technical proficiency, teamwork, and problem\-solving abilities. Selected candidates may be asked to undertake a technical assessment and participate in multiple interview rounds.
 



 This role offers a stimulating environment for networking professionals passionate about Juniper technologies and eager to make a tangible impact on mission\-critical networks

**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

 We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our team (5\+yrs). Cloudflare is building one of the largest, most resilient networks that spans over 335 cities spread across all regions and we plan to continue our expansion at a rapid pace. You will have the opportunity to (literally) build a faster, safer Internet for our millions of users and the billions of web surfers that visit their sites each month.
   

  

 This position will be responsible for :
   

  

* Technical operation and engineering of the Cloudflare network, including the provisioning and management of the network hardware and software,
* Day to day network operations and monitoring, working closely with internal teams such as System Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering and Customer Support teams,
* Creating and maintaining documentation, SOP’s, knowledge base,
* Interacting with our network peers to assist with their inquiries, and subsequently provide meaningful data on performance degradation.


**Requirements** 
 :
   

  

* Capable of learning new technologies / systems / features under guidance of mentors,
* Proficient in multiple network vendor operating systems , Associate level network certification(s) (JNCIA , CCNA , etc) or higher,
* Understanding of BGP, Knowledge of the OSI\-model and experience isolating network, hardware and software issues,
* Experience writing scripts in Bash, Python, or other scripting language,
* Experience in working as part of a team in a customer\-facing role,
* Ability to prioritise when faced with high pressure scenarios.


**Bonus Points but not required:**
* Understanding of anycast routing,
* Good working knowledge of Junos, IOS\-XR,NX\-OS, EOS and SONIC,
* Experience writing network configuration and design documentation,
* Experience solving problems through automation,
* Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM/DWDM,
* Linux system administration,
* Multilingual.


**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
   

  

**Project Galileo**

title: HPC Engineer - Network
description:
**Role Title:** 
 HPC Engineer \- Network
   

  

**Location:** 
 India (Must align with Client Time Zone)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **HPC Engineer \- Network** 
 acts as the primary execution engine for the connectivity that binds the AI Factory together. While the Domain Architect designs the topology and the Senior Engineer directs the squad, you are the "Builder" responsible for configuring, stabilising, and tuning the high\-speed interconnects. You are a "doer" who is as comfortable debugging a flapping InfiniBand link via CLI as you are pushing a configuration update to fifty switches using Ansible.
   

  

 As a System Integrator, we design and deliver bespoke, high\-scale AI factories. In this role, you will move beyond standard enterprise networking (campus/wifi) to execute the deployment of lossless, high\-bandwidth fabrics for
 **NVIDIA SuperPOD, NVIDIA BasePOD, and Cisco AI Factory** 
 environments.
   

  

 In this role, you will operate with a
 **100% focus on Delivery** 
 , executing the Low\-Level Designs (LLD) assigned by your Squad Lead. You will own the "Network" in the critical "Compute\-Network\-Storage" triad, ensuring that the GPU compute nodes can communicate at line rate without congestion.
   

  

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENT:** 
 This role typically operates on
 **Shift Hours** 
 to align with the onshore client's time zone (e.g., early shifts for Australian clients, or split shifts for European clients).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Fabric Configuration \& Provisioning
* Switch Configuration: Execute the configuration of high\-performance switches (NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand, NVIDIA Spectrum\-X Ethernet, Cisco Nexus) using defined templates and automation.
* NetDevOps Execution: Run and maintain Ansible playbooks to push configurations, update firmware (Cumulus/NX\-OS), and enforce compliance across the fabric.
* Subnet Management: Configure and tune NVIDIA Unified Fabric Manager (UFM) to ensure optimal routing and fault tolerance.
* Host Networking: Assist the Compute team in configuring host\-side adapters (ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs) to ensure correct IP addressing, MTU, and driver parameters.
* Validation \& Performance Tuning
* Link Validation: Verify physical connectivity and link health using tools like ibstat, ibdiagnet, and ethtool to identify faulty cables or transceivers immediately after installation by Field Engineers.
* Performance Testing: Execute network\-specific benchmarks (e.g., ib\_write\_bw, ib\_send\_bw, NCCL\-tests) to validate that the fabric is delivering full bi\-sectional bandwidth and low latency.
* Congestion Control: Implement and tune Quality of Service (QoS) settings, including Priority Flow Control (PFC), Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN), and Data Center Quantized Congestion Notification (DCQCN) to prevent packet loss and optimize throughput in RoCEv2 environments.
* Operations \& Support
* Fabric Telemetry: Configure monitoring agents (e.g., Prometheus node exporters, UFM Telemetry) to visualize traffic flows and detect "tail latency" issues.
* Ticket Resolution: Handle L2 support tickets for network issues, such as "Node isolation," "Slow All\-Reduce operations," or "Fabric flapping."
* Lifecycle Management: Execute firmware upgrades on switches and DPUs during maintenance windows, ensuring strict compatibility with the NVIDIA OFED stack.


 ,
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
**Essential Skills**
**High\-Performance Networking:**
* InfiniBand Mastery: Deep operational knowledge of NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand switches, cable types (NDR/HDR), and troubleshooting commands.
* AI Ethernet (RoCEv2\): Solid understanding of RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCEv2\), including the configuration of PFC and ECN on switches (Spectrum/Arista/Cisco/Juniper).
* Fabric Management: Experience with NVIDIA UFM (Unified Fabric Manager) for managing large\-scale fabrics.


**Automation \& Tools:**
* NetDevOps: Proficiency in Ansible for network automation (e.g., ansible\-networking collections).
* Linux Networking: Comfortable navigating Linux CLI to troubleshoot host\-side networking (ip link, tcpdump, sysctl tuning).
* Protocol Knowledge: Practical implementation skills in BGP, EVPN, and VXLAN for multi\-tenant AI clouds.


**Desirable Experience**
* Cisco AI Integration: Experience with Cisco Nexus Dashboard or Cisco 8000 series in an AI context.
* DPU Configuration: Experience configuring NVIDIA BlueField DPUs and working with the DOCA framework.
* Optical Networking: Ability to interpret transceiver signal levels (DOM/DDM) to diagnose Layer 1 optical faults.
* AI Fabric Orchestration: Experience deploying and managing AI clusters using Netris or Cisco Nexus Hyperfabric AI to automate fabric provisioning and operations.


**Certifications**
**Highly Desirable:**
* NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Networking (NCP\-AIN)
* NVIDIA\-Certified Associate: AI Infrastructure and Operations (NCA\-AIIO)
* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Data Center


**Success Metrics (KPIs)**
* Fabric Efficiency: Achieving \>95% effective bandwidth efficiency on NCCL\-test benchmarks across the provisioned cluster.
* Layer 1 Accuracy: Zero "ghost links" or unstable connections handed over to the Compute team (all bad cables identified during the burn\-in phase).
* Ticket Velocity: Consistently meeting SLAs for network\-related support tickets.

 You'll need to learn GEO if you haven't worked with it yet. This is emerging, and we're figuring it out as the space evolves.
 



  







 Own the Results
 



  





 You're not just writing. You're responsible for traffic, engagement, backlinks, and conversions. If something isn't working, you figure out why and fix it.
 



  





 Who You Are
 



  







 You Have Technical Depth
 


* You've written technical content before (AI, ML, developer tools, or similar fields)
* You understand how to read documentation and explain APIs, models, and systems
* You're comfortable talking to engineers and translating their work into clear stories





 You Use AI Tools Daily
 


* You already use Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or similar tools to research and write faster
* You understand how AI is changing content creation
* You're experimenting with new tools and workflows constantly





 You're a Generalist
 


* You can switch between writing a technical blog, creating a GEO page, planning content refreshes, and writing on Reddit in the same week
* You don't need someone to tell you exactly what to do. You figure it out.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and building things from scratch





 You Care About Outcomes
 


* You track metrics: traffic, time on page, backlinks, conversions
* You kill what doesn't work and double down on what does
* You want your content to drive real business results for clients





 You Work Independently
 


* You don't need detailed briefs or constant check\-ins
* You research, propose ideas, and execute on your own
* You're fine with: "Here's the client, here's the goal. Figure out the best approach."



  





  





 What We Offer
 



  







 Fully remote. Work from anywhere in India.
 





 Founding role. You'll shape how we create content for AI companies from day one.
 





 AI\-first environment. We use the best tools and expect you to do the same.
 





 Direct client work. You'll be on calls with AI companies, understanding what they're building and creating content that drives their growth.
 





 Fast learning. You'll work with cutting\-edge AI companies and see what's being built before it's public.
 



  





 This Role Is Not For You If:
 



  







 You want a predictable 9\-to\-5 with the same tasks every week
 





 You need someone to give you detailed instructions for every piece you write
 





 You're a generalist writer who can write about anything but doesn't care about the technology
 





 You're not comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter
 





 You need stability over learning and building
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  







 Send an email to fatima@devable.ai / sumanth@devable.ai with:
 



  





 1\. Your best technical writing sample
 



  





 Link to one published piece. Ideally about AI, ML, or developer tools. We want to see technical depth and clear writing.
 



  





 2\. A short pitch (200 words max)
 



  





 Tell us:
 



  




* Why this role specifically excites you
* One piece of content you'd create for an AI company in your first month and how you'd make sure it ranks
* How you currently use AI tools in your writing process



  





  





 3\. Your LinkedIn profile
 



  





 That's it. No formal resume needed.
 



  





 Subject line: Founding Technical Writer \- \[Your Name]
 



  





 All the best!

title: Technical Writer
description:
eProductivity Software is looking for a Technical Writer to join our team.
   

  

 This person will contribute to the development and maintenance of written technical product information to improve the implementation, maintenance, and use of the products. They will also provide technical writing support for other groups within the organization.
   

  

 This position will be based in Bangalore India and is part of a documentation team located across the world. Please provide a portfolio of work samples.
   

  

**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** 
  

  

- Develop and maintain product related documentation by gathering information from subject\-matter experts as part of a product team.

- Adhere to guidelines/direction and deadlines established by project lead and defined by release schedule. The documentation can include but is not limited to:

* User Guides
* Release Notes
* Installation Guide
* Integration Guides
* WebHelp
* Tutorials
* Videos
* Maintain intimate familiarity with products and their functionality and attend regular product team meetings.
* Provide internal point of contact for documentation support.
* Help define processes for documentation in an agile environment that improve the efficiently of the flow of information between developers, QA and documentation.
* Provide feedback on the design and UI of the product.


**Leadership And Working With Others**
* Technical Writers
* Consultants
* Product Managers
* Business Analysts
* QA Engineers
* Support Team
* Professional Services


**Qualifications And Experience**
* BA/BS degree with a Technical Communications, English, Education, or Training focus preferred.
* 3\-5 years of technical writing experience for software products.
* Knowledge of printing industry is preferable but manufacturing and ERP also beneficial.
* Knowledge of CSS and Help Output Configuration is preferred but not required.
* Knowledge of basic JavaScript is preferred but not required.
* Experience adhering to style guides / standards.
* Able to work independently within guidelines provided.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams a plus.
* Experience creating video demos is a plus.
* Ability to plan, structure and write user guides and help systems with minimal guidance in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, writing, editing, and project management skills.
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to learn and work with unfamiliar tools.
* Attention to detail and ability to multi\-task.


**Technology And Tools**
* Microsoft Office 365
* RoboHelp or similar authoring tools
* GitHub or similar version control system preferred but not required
* Enjoyhint or a similar overlay interactive tutorial software preferred but not required
* Camtasia or video editing software preferred but not required

title: Specialist Technical Writer
description:
We are looking for a technical writer who will be responsible for planning, creating, and managing multiple high\-quality content assets in parallel—working with internal experts and SMEs to define topics, audiences, and key messages. Produces clear, accurate, SEO\-optimized, customer\-facing content (datasheets, app notes, whitepapers, etc.) while adhering to corporate standards, style guidelines, and review/approval workflows.
   

  

**Your Role**
 Key responsibilities in your new role
   

  

* Manage the creation of multiple content pieces simultaneously, managing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Coordinate with internal experts to define topics, shape storylines, identify audiences, and source supporting documentation (datasheets, app notes, webinars, whitepapers, etc.).
* Interview SMEs to capture accurate technical details and translate them into clear, customer\-facing content.
* Write, edit, and refine content for clarity, accuracy, and consistency; produce drafts quickly and iterate based on reviews.
* Adhere to corporate standards: follow templates, terminology, style guidelines, and approval workflows; maintain version control and review history as required.
* Apply SEO practices and structure content for answer\-oriented discovery.


**Your Profile**
**Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed**
* Strong understanding of power semiconductors (e.g., MOSFETs, IGBTs,SiC/GaN, etc.).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills; comfortable driving conversations with SMEs and aligning stakeholders.
* Skilled at turning complex information into clear, structured, audience\-appropriate content.
* Profound experience in creating and editing technical articles as well as in content development in general
* Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Media/Communication and passion for communication/writing
* Proficient MS office skills (PowerPoint, Excel), Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator)
* Fluent English skills with German as a plus


**Contact:**
 Pooja.AnandaChowta@infineon.com

* Level of expertise and education (e.g., PhD holders may qualify for higher rates)

* Geographic location
* Specific project requirements and urgency

 TELUS Digital AI Community
